Kaji2021WeakIdentification gives general weak-regularity impossibility; the stated hidden-treatment fiber criterion is a model-specific application.
EvansHansenStark2005Minimax establishes minimax expected-measure duality for restricted location parameters, not a curved hidden-treatment Gaussian fiber with randomized connected endpoint kernels.

EvansHansenStark2005Minimax supplies the general minimax expected-measure comparison framework, but not the calibrated profile-hull rule on this fiber.

novelty_flags.label: related_work and comparator_promise_table: SchlemperMoreira2026ConfidenceSets
novelty_flags.one_line: The proposal attributes the coverage-error result to Proposition 5, but the inspected arXiv paper states that result as Proposition 1.

novelty_flags.label: related_work, literature_checklist, and Zhou comparator claim
novelty_flags.one_line: The cited v4 Theorem 7 is a Donsker/nuisance-rate theorem under Assumptions 2–5 with proof in Supplement S17; it is not a theorem stated under a fixed lower outcome-relevance margin or in Supplement S2.

soundness_flags.label: ass:known-effect-radius and ass:local-radius-scaling
soundness_flags.one_line: A clinically fixed equivalence tolerance does not naturally form a known sequence r_n shrinking as n^{-1/2}; specify an actual n-indexed design/scientific calibration or retain this only as an abstract local experiment.

soundness_flags.label: def:adaptive-iid-rule and thm:zhou-agreement-frontier
soundness_flags.one_line: C_n is not a determinate statistic: the definition does not specify an estimator of q_n, chart/face selection, or the transport map, while I_n^{ZTT} and v_eff are not indexed by P_n despite the supremum over arbitrary triangular subfamilies.

soundness_flags.label: prop:bounded-normal-active-face
soundness_flags.one_line: X_G=⟨k,G⟩/κ is ill-typed because k is an eta-indexed field of L2(q) functions whereas G is in R^{3J}; the proposition must name the singleton eta and its B-coordinate vector.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: thm:connected-saddle through oeq:uniform-iid-lift
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: The Gaussian endpoint-kernel results are conditional decision-theory claims and do not themselves establish a sampled-data causal confidence interval.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: The saddle, certificate, profile-regret, and active-face claims are evaluated only within the declared fixed-J Gaussian local experiment unless the moving-fiber lift is separately proved.

source_verification_receipts.locator: pp. 9, Assumptions 2–3; p. 25, Theorem 7; p. 75, Supplement S17
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: Assumption 2 requires Y, A, and Z each to be associated with the hidden treatment; Theorem 7 additionally assumes Assumptions 2–5, bounded Y, Donsker and nuisance-rate conditions, and its proof is explicitly labelled S17.
The paper's uniform-approximation statement says coverage differs from nominal by at most epsilon and is numbered Proposition 1, not Proposition 5.

source_verification_receipts.version: Technical Report 617, revised 23 May 2003; corroborating prepublication version
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: For a bounded normal mean, the truncated Pratt procedure attains the minimax expected-measure value when tau is at most 2z_{1-alpha}; the report also treats nuisance-parameter confidence-set problems.

source_verification_receipts.locator: pp. 291–293 introduction and tripod parametrization; p. 302, Proposition 4.1
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper parameterizes binary latent-tree models and studies geometry of unidentified fibers, including the tripod model, but contains no confidence-interval decision problem.

The theorem provides limits over strong, semi-strong, and weak sequences; the weak case has a changing local parameter domain and nonstandard limit, rather than Le Cam deficiency equivalence for a moving latent fiber.

The article studies weak regularity, impossibility of consistent/equivariant estimation, and underlying regular parameters; it does not state the proposal's hidden-treatment posterior-contrast criterion.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Replace the fixed-tolerance rationale for sqrt(n)r_n→rho with a concrete sequence of studies whose externally supplied calibration precision shrinks at that rate, or explicitly remove prospective applied claims and present the local experiment as asymptotic theory only.

Make the adaptive sample rule total: define q-hat_n, the finite/cone chart selector, the endpoint-kernel transport, and P_n-indexed ZTT variance and estimator before asserting the uniform agreement theorem.

Correct the two citation characterizations and add exact theorem/section anchors for every comparator claim; retain Theorem 7 only as a regular fixed-margin benchmark under its actual Donsker and nuisance-rate hypotheses.

Write the bounded-normal reduction with an explicit singleton-fiber eta and B-transformed contrast vector, then provide the algebra yielding kappa and the strict profile-regret calculation as a reproducible worked certificate.

recommended_next_step: Revise the cited-comparator descriptions and make the adaptive and active-face objects mathematically total; then retain the Gaussian saddle and moving-fiber OEQ as a field-tier novelty kernel.
